provenance.note: Where on the channel the modelled stretch STARTS, as a Point: the pick's {coordinates, name} verbatim, a (lon, lat) pair, 'lat,lon', a point layer. Geocode a place name first. It seeds the reach the domain is cut from; supply the domain polygon - a lake, a pond, a harbour - instead and this is not read [supplied on this invocation]

Where the temperature series and its diurnal range are read, as a Point: the pick's {coordinates, name} verbatim, a (lon, lat) pair, 'lat,lon' or a point layer. Geocode a place name first [supplied on this invocation]

Target element edge length the domain is triangulated at; a surface heat budget is divided by the local DEPTH, so what this has to resolve is how deep the water is rather than its planform [supplied on this invocation]

The moment the scenario is read at - an ISO date or datetime ('2026-08-20' or '2026-08-20T06:00:00Z'), from phrasing like 'during last Tuesday's storm'. Each source keeps its own retention, and a request deeper than one refuses typed [supplied on this invocation]

Which kind of water the seed is on: 'reach' (default) cuts a stretch of river from the mapped channel; 'waterbody' takes the lake, pond or reservoir the seed stands in. Read only when no domain polygon is supplied [declared question default]
Solve sizing class - how many cores the solve is partitioned across. An engine that runs on one core says so on the card [declared constant default]

Vertical datum this run counts every elevation from - the bed under it and the level over it. A source published on another frame reaches this one through a measured offset, and a pair nobody publishes an offset between refuses by name [declared constant default]
